falsifiersBothDirections.extraDefectFoundByTheFalsifiers: The F4 'refuses a determination with no basis' fixture failed on first run and exposed a real bug in the new code: normalizeAdoptedCityLimitsEtj spread the incoming fact and then overrode only the fields the resolver produced, so a REFUSED etjFact block (and a stale etjConflict/etjReason from an earlier state) leaked through verbatim. Fixed by destructuring the four ETJ fields out before spreading, and pinned by two new tests (a stale conflict must not survive the city-limits reading changing; a stale reason must not survive a determination arriving). Found by test, not by review.
